title: Zero-length iterated $L^p$ norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\lambda$ be a probability law on $\Omega$, let $p\in\mathbb R$, and let $f:\Omega^0\to\mathbb R$. The length-zero iterated $L^p$ norm of $f$ is the absolute value of its value at the unique empty tuple.
